title: Woman Bites Officer’s Leg During Arrest
description:
On October 6, 2021, officers were dispatched to a domestic call in La Crosse, WI. When Police arrived, they made contact with the 40-year-old woman. She explained she had gotten into an argument with her mother over money. Moments later, she claimed she didn't know the other woman (her mother). She then attempted to open the front door and go inside but got absolutely nowhere...
